exercise.label: Change
exercise.task: How can a tiny-sample draft be repaired with flow on the horizontal axis? Each row is one ink-flow trial. Use the rows specified below from df. Clear the supplied illustrative violin draft. Replace it with every raw flow reading by ink using jitter=False, with flow on x and ink on y. Restore title Ink flow trials and labels flow/ink; repeated flow=7 trials are separate records. Detailed density shapes are unsupported by these tiny groups. Chart: title "Ink flow trials"; x "flow"; y "ink".
exercise.solution:
ax.clear()
sns.stripplot(data=df, x="flow", y="ink", jitter=False, ax=ax)
ax.set(title="Ink flow trials", xlabel="flow", ylabel="ink")
fig.tight_layout()
plt.show()
